title: nf-oracles
objective: Create the offline cross-system oracle corpus, regeneration harnesses, structural checker, and benchmark workloads for all phases.
references: SageMath 10.9.post1 number-field, PARI L-function, and unit/class-group APIs

handoff.summary: Added a versioned 24-field offline corpus spanning degrees 1-6, all requested signatures, both quadratic signs, nonmaximal and genuinely nonmonogenic presentations, exact HNF prime decompositions, a_1 through a_64, analytic values/jets/residues/completions through 200 bits with selected 512-bit cases, Kronecker edge cases, fundamental units, regulators, and class groups. Added deterministic structural reconstruction tests, persistent Sage/PARI and Magma harnesses, and five digest-checked benchmark workloads. The offline checker also passed unchanged under native Windows Node.js.
risks: Analytic values are sourced from Sage/PARI; Magma 2.18-5 independently corroborates exact invariants and prime decompositions only.
Hecke/Oscar was probed but Julia was not provisioned on the regeneration host, so that independent family is explicitly recorded as unavailable.
Unit generators are canonical only up to the usual sign, inverse, torsion, and basis changes; consumers should verify generated subgroups and regulators rather than compare display strings blindly.
next_steps: Add test/number-field-foundations-oracle.cjs to the shared unit-test manifest in the integration lane.
Run the arithmetic-algebra lane's broad strict/native validation after the coordinator's active shared build completes; the coordinator explicitly deferred those gates for this data-only lane.
Have each implementation phase consume the relevant corpus projection and preserve the benchmark workload result digests.
Add a Hecke/Oscar independent snapshot if a Julia environment with those packages becomes available.
